{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2oa
|version1= 1.52

|game2= tkoh
|version2= 1.00

|game3= arma3
|version3= 0.50

|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= Turrets

|descr= Adds a magazine to the turret. Use turret path {{hl|[-1]}} for driver's turret.
{{Feature|important|Invalid combinations may be created by using this command, for example by adding 20 grenades. In these cases, behaviour is undefined.}}

|s1= vehicle [[addMagazineTurret]] [magazineName, turretPath, ammoCount]

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= magazineName: [[String]]

|p3= turretPath: [[Turret Path]]

|p4= ammoCount: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) desired ammo count
|p4since= arma3 1.56

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_tank addMagazineTurret ["SmokeLauncherMag", [0,0]];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_tank addMagazineTurret ["20Rnd_120mmSABOT_M1A2", [0]];</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>_tank addMagazineTurret ["20Rnd_120mmSABOT_M1A2", [0], 10]; // add magazine with 10 rounds</sqf>
